events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

events.name: get_customer
events.result:
C-0415 Lindqvist Marine. Account manager: Elena Park. Credit limit 50,000.00.
Payment history: 34 invoices, 0 late in 24 months.

events.name: get_credit_policy
events.result:
Account managers may approve credit limits up to 100,000.00 for their own accounts.
Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

args.reason_for_change: Requested by Elena Park (account manager for C-0415): customer signed three-year contract. Within AM approval authority (up to 100,000). Previous limit 50,000.

events.name: update_credit_limit

args.reason_for_change: Requested by Elena Park (account manager for C-0415): customer signed three-year contract. Within AM approval authority (up to 100,000). Previous limit 50,000.

events.result: Credit limit for C-0415 set to 80000. Reason recorded.

events.text:
C-0415 (Lindqvist Marine) now has a credit limit of 80,000, up from 50,000.

- Elena is the account manager on the account, and 80,000 is under the 100,000 account-manager approval ceiling in the credit policy.
- The customer has paid all 34 invoices on time over the last 24 months.
- The change reason records Elena's request and the new three-year contract.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: Before updating, the agent checked that Elena was the account manager and that policy allowed account managers to approve limits up to 100,000 for their own accounts.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason_for_change field recorded 'Requested by Elena Park' and 'customer signed three-year contract.'

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent put the reason in reason_for_change, and the update tool confirmed 'Reason recorded.'

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent confirmed the new limit of 80,000 and stated, 'The change reason records Elena's request and the new three-year contract.'
